title: Na$_{2}$SO$_{4}$ (III) Structure
comments:
Na$_{2}$SO$_{4}$ forms in many anhydroous phases (Nord, 1973), which we will reference as we update this site. For now we have \begin{itemize} \item \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B4C_oC28_63_ac_fg_c-001}{Na$_{2}$SO$_{4}$ III} (this structure) and \item \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B4C_oF56_70_e_h_a-001}{Thenardite (Na$_{2}$SO$_{4}$ V, $H1_{7}$)}. \end{itemize} ~ \vspace{-.25in} 
 (Frevel, 1940) put this structure in the $Pbnn$ setting of space group \#52, but AFLOW shows that the positions of the atoms are consistent with the higher symmetry $Cmcm$ \#63 space group.  Transforming from $Pbnn$ to $Cmcm$ halves the size of the unit cell. 
 The date for this structure was taken at room temperature. 
 The lattice constants in the ICSD differ slightly (less than 1\%) from the published values in (Frevel, 1940). Ordinarily we would use the published values, but since there is a space group shift here we decided to use the ICSD values to avoid confusion.
